proposal.summary: The report describes SQL injection vulnerabilities (boolean-based blind and time-based) in Suprema BioStar 2 v2.8.16 at the endpoint /api/users/absence?search_month=1 via the JSON "values" parameter, allowing remote unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL queries and extract database contents.
proposal.cwe_quote: A Boolean-based SQL injection/Time based SQL vulnerability in the page (/api/users/absence?search_month=1) in Suprema BioStar 2 v2.8.16 allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute remote arbitrary SQL commands through "values" JSON parameter.

AV.quote: A Boolean-based SQL injection/Time based SQL vulnerability in the page (/api/users/absence?search_month=1) in Suprema BioStar 2 v2.8.16 allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute remote arbitrary SQL commands through "values" JSON parameter.

PR.quote: allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute remote arbitrary SQL commands through "values" JSON parameter.

C.quote: the exploit demonstrates retrieving database names and contents via sqlmap (e.g. "retrieved: biostar2_ac").

I.quote: the exploit demonstrates retrieving database names and contents via sqlmap (e.g. "retrieved: biostar2_ac").

A.quote: Time based SQL injection (set 4 – response delays for 8 seconds).

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerability against an up-to-date instance, reproduce the injection with minimal PoC, identify affected query construction, and implement parameterized queries or proper input validation and escaping; if confirmed, prepare coordinated disclosure and provide upgrade or mitigation guidance.
